items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: It's Richard Voic, it's for him. Well, if any way he working, I can't work his instrument. Any right-hand man, I can work the instrument. Because Selby Thomas was a right-hand man. Then I used to get up and... Play a little...

ctx.x: I wondered why her name was, they called her Mother Richards, I remember, wasn't it? That was her, that was her. Was it Richardson or Richards?
Richard. Mother Richards. Well that was her other marriage name.
I didn't know she just took that name as an evangelist. No, no. She was married. With the, for the Richardson.
